note: Real Grok `permission_denied` hook payloads (issue #4189), redacted. Source: the host's Kookr hook logs (~/.kookr/hooks/*.jsonl.gz), which held 283 permission_denied events captured 2026-08-12 -> 2026-08-18 from Kookr-launched Grok sessions. Every one ran in permissionMode "bypassPermissions" and had toolInputTruncated:false. Tool mix: 277 run_terminal_command{command,description}, 5 run_terminal_command{command,description,timeout}, 1 grep{pattern,path}; one sample of each shape is kept below. Grok build at capture time: unknown (the hook payload does not carry it; the build installed on 2026-11-18 is 1.0.35, which did not necessarily produce these). Redaction: session ids, tool-use uuids, cwd/workspace/transcript paths, commands, descriptions, grep pattern and path are placeholders; every key, key order, value type, timestamp, tool name, permissionMode, the numeric timeout and the toolUseId call-<uuid>-<n> layout are real. Not captured: a non-bypass (interactive permission menu) permission_denied and any toolInputTruncated:true payload - both remain unverified. Collect: zcat ~/.kookr/hooks/*.jsonl.gz | grep -a '"permission_denied"' (grep -a: without it grep stops at the first binary-looking line).
